What a bite does

Severe local tissue destruction and coagulopathy develop over hours to a couple of days.

Name and taxonomy. Distinct from Bothrops atrox (Common lancehead).

If you are bitten

Get to a hospital that holds antivenom. Keep still, remove rings and watches, and do not cut, suck or tie off the bite. Use the red “Bitten?” button at the top of any page.
